description: This file defines a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' for aggregating agent usage and costs across session tracking and language model costs collections in a MongoDB database. It includes internal helper functions for parsing currency strings, builds complex aggregation pipelines, and processes the aggregated data to produce a summarized report suitable for frontend consumption.
